caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high seat and a low backrest, positioned within a thin rectangular border centered on a plain, off-white background. The chair is rendered in naturalistic colors, mainly muted greens and browns, with variations indicating wood grain, wear, and dimensional shading. The chair features four legs, each slightly splayed outward for stability, with two horizontal supports connecting the front and back legs at different heights. The seat is flat with slightly rounded edges. The backrest has a horizontal upper rail supported by five vertical spindles, and the ends of the backrest curve outward. The perspective shows the chair from a slightly elevated front angle, and no other objects or decorations are present in the drawing.
title: Baby High Chair
